Thanks for the context. Short answer: possibly, with controls. Long answer: procurement policy requires a PO for most suppliers, but we do permit temporary invoice-only onboarding for short pilots under the following guardrails:

1) Spend cap: $25,000 cumulative (we can set $20k as requested but our default temporary cap is $25k).
2) Duration: max 90 days.
3) Required docs: signed SOW, W9, proof of CI insurance (vendor confirms), and completed vendor onboarding form (I’ve attached the form to this thread).
4) Approvals: Procurement lead + Finance ops approval required; exception recorded in the vendor portal with the exception reason.

Operationally we will:
- Create a temporary vendor record scoped to "Invoice-only pilot" with an auto-expiry date.
- Flag invoices routed to Finance with a manual review tag.

Marissa — if you confirm this is acceptable we’ll run approvals today and provision the vendor by EOD tomorrow. Karthik — please advise if security needs to review the pilot (I assume a light questionnaire is fine for this integration).

Kimberly Park
Procurement Manager, Redwood Inference
Attachments: vendor_onboarding_form.pdf (stub)

- We prefer spend cap $20k to match internal forecast; happy to include an auto-expiry clause at 90 days.
